intro: Torek's Assault is a direct Horde raid launched from the wilds of Ashenvale against the nearby night elf garrison at Silverwing Outpost. Led by the orc raider Torek under orders from Splintertree Post, the strike aims to crush local Sentinel resistance and slay their commander, Duriel Moonfire. It marks one of the most brazen, bloody skirmishes in the ongoing war for Ashenvale's borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My raiders and I are about to attack the Silverwing Outpost to the west. Our target is its leader, Duriel Moonfire. Scouts report the outpost is defended heavily with sentinels and warriors. The battle will be glorious!
Do you want to share in the glory, friend, and aid us? If so, then when it's over you can report our success to my superior, Ertog Ragetusk in Splintertree.
What do you say. Are you with us?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Torek was sent on a mission against Silverwing Outpost. Was the attack successful?

clips.title: Completion
paras: So Torek's attack was successful! Well done, friend. Night elves are decent foes. A little skinny, but strong and fierce! I'm sure the battle was something to see...
And I hope you gained a scar or two!
